item.title: Under the Hood: Deconstructing Godot's Engine Architecture
item.description: The Godot Engine has rapidly grown in popularity, admired for its open-source nature, intuitive editor, and efficient workflow. While many appreciate its user-friendly interface, the true power and flexibility of Godot lie in its elegant, component-based architecture and robust extensibility mechanisms. This deep dive aims to pull back the curtain, exploring the core engine design, GDScript’s internals, and how Godot enables high-performance extensions. The Recursive Heartbeat: Godot’s Scene Tree and Nodes At the very foundation of every Godot project is the Scene Tree.
